XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Battery fault warning light comes on, "Charging system fault" warning
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | U0065 | P1B00 | P1B01 | ALTERNATOR | RECHARGE | CHARGE | 11 VOLTS | CHARGING | RED |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Alternator

  • Fault: Permanent battery fault warning light, "Charging system fault" warning

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0065, P1B00, P1B01

  • Cause: Faulty alternator

• Action: Replace the alternator

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The alternator is located in the passenger side engine compartment.
    The faulty alternator did not show any obvious visual abnormalities.
    Following replacement of the alternator, no adjustment via diagnosis is necessary.
